title: Buffett and Jay Pritzker: contractual event arbitrage

sources.sourceRole: Primary publication; account may be retrospective or interested-party

documentedClaim: Completion probability, capital lockup and failure losses govern event spreads; the Rockwood example joined securities and warehouse receipts.
inferredMechanism: An announced event changes security-holder rights and can create a spread while access, uncertainty or complexity limits participation.
counterevidence: Deal financing can fail, consideration can change, and reported wins do not describe the full opportunity universe.
transferRequirements: Verify every contract version, broker processing deadline, deliverability, commissions and realistic deployable capacity.
outcomeBoundary: Public narrative already inspected; described cases are discovery examples, never untouched confirmation. No experimental market outcome dataset opened.
